clue.text: Composer recalling jazz music directed by untrained couple of devotees

indicators.note: to recall is to call back, so the whole string of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: ragtime, or rag, is an early jazz style
led means directed or guided
raw means inexperienced or untrained
the first two letters of the word devotees

explanation.surface: A composer looks back on jazz played under the baton of a pair of amateur fans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalling' turns the whole run RAG + LED + RAW + DE backwards; 'by' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The Englishman who wrote the Enigma Variations is a classic example of a composer.

clue.text: Engineers turning up to conceal trick — source of work?

indicators.note: one piece hides another inside it, so the corps letters wrap round the trick
in a down clue, turning up means the letters are read from the bottom, i.e. backwards

parts.note: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps
a ploy is a trick or ruse

explanation.surface: Engineers arrive to hide some trickery, and someone asks who is giving them work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses the corps letters (a down clue reads upwards) to EMER; 'to conceal' wraps them round the trick. The question mark marks an indirect definition: an employer gives work.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss who hires staff is where a job comes from; the question mark flags the indirect phrasing.

clue.text: Colourless king entering action became incoherent

parts.note: wan means pale or colourless

indicators.note: the king's letter goes into the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A pale monarch steps into the action and starts to ramble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' builds DERED; 'Colourless' looks like a description of the king but is a separate piece.
explanation.definitionFit: When speech drifts off topic it is said to have strayed or rambled.

clue.text: Arrive at portion of stream

definitions.meaning: a stretch of a river between two bends

explanation.definitionFit: To get to somewhere is a synonym; a straight stretch of river is also called this.

clue.text: Refined drug supplied around US state

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: the word for supplied is placed around the state's abbreviation

parts.note: lent means provided or supplied
GA is the postal abbreviation for Georgia

explanation.surface: A drug is handed out around an American state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' builds LEGANT; 'drug' is crossword shorthand for ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Polished, graceful and stylish are near synonyms.

clue.text: High-ranking figure close to marquee in cultivated garden

indicators.note: the last letter goes inside the rearranged garden
a garden that is cultivated is worked over, so its letters are rearranged
the close of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A dignitary stands near a marquee in a well-tended garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cultivated' rearranges GARDEN to GRANDE; 'close to' gives the E of marquee, which goes 'in' at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish or Portuguese nobleman of top rank, and by extension any important person.

clue.text: Intelligence needed by one running estate, possibly

definitions.text: Intelligence needed by one running estate, possibly

parts.words: Intelligence needed by one running estate, possibly
parts.note: an estate is also a type of car, so the person running it is a motorist, who needs awareness of traffic

explanation.surface: A manager of a country estate needs brains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'estate' suggests land, but in Britain an estate is a station wagon, and running one means driving.
explanation.definitionFit: The instinctive awareness a driver needs to stay safe on the highway.

clue.text: Curve in covered passageway half obscured

indicators.note: half of the word is hidden from view, so its last three letters are removed

parts.note: an arcade is a covered walk lined with shops

explanation.surface: A curve sits inside a half-darkened covered walkway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half obscured' cuts ARCADE back to its first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A bow-shaped line is a segment of a circle.

clue.text: A meeting-place providing means of access

parts.note: a venue is where people gather

explanation.surface: A meeting-place offers a way in.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively a route or approach, as in an avenue for complaints.

clue.text: Party treat top European inspiring a bit of news

indicators.note: to inspire is literally to breathe in, so the outer pieces take in the others

parts.note: a cap is a lid or top

indicators.note: a bit of a word is its first letter here

explanation.surface: A leading European takes in a snippet of news at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspiring' puts A + N (the first letter of news) inside CAPE, between C and APE.
explanation.definitionFit: A small savoury on a cracker or bread served at drinks is a classic party snack.

clue.text: Animal revealing different elements of old man?

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father; its first letter
the separate letters of the word for the father are listed with and between them
the second letter of pa

explanation.surface: A creature shows various sides of an elderly father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old man' is PA, whose two elements are P and A; spelt out, that is P AND A.
explanation.definitionFit: The black-and-white bear of China is a well-known creature.

clue.text: Battle site gives scare right away to English hemmed in by westerly river

indicators.note: the reversed river wraps round the other pieces
in an across clue, going west means reading right to left, i.e. backwards

parts.note: the Nile is the great river of Egypt

indicators.note: the letter R, for right, is taken away

parts.note: alarm means a fright or scare

explanation.surface: A battlefield frightens the English, who are trapped by a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'westerly' reverses NILE to ELIN; 'right away' cuts ALARM to ALAM; ALAM + E is 'hemmed in by' ELIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian desert where the 1942 Second World War battle was fought.

clue.text: Finished former Tory reportedly gets caught by chance

parts.note: over means finished or ended

indicators.note: reported speech means the name is heard, not read

parts.note: Douglas Hurd was a Conservative Foreign Secretary

explanation.surface: A one-time Conservative is finished and gets caught out by bad luck.
explanation.walkthrough: Douglas HURD, a 1990s British Foreign Secretary, sounds like HEARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Listened in on something accidentally, without intending to eavesdrop.

clue.text: Floor taken by boss endlessly accompanied by politician

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a stud is a boss, a raised knob or rivet head
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone in charge takes the floor with a politician beside them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' is the knob, not the manager. 'Floor' is a verb: to baffle.
explanation.definitionFit: To floor someone is to baffle them, as a hard question does.

clue.text: Some believer esteeming mountain

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A believer holds a mountain in high regard.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's highest peak, in the Himalayas.

clue.text: Mug providing comfortable sensation

definitions.meaning: a gullible person, easily taken in
read literally, a relaxed feel or contact

explanation.definitionFit: A pushover who lends money readily; read word by word, a gentle feel.

clue.text: Most of range repelled girl

indicators.note: pushed back, so the letters are read in reverse
the last letter is dropped

parts.note: the Andes are the South American mountain range

explanation.surface: A girl is driven back from most of a mountain range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of' trims ANDES to ANDE, and 'repelled' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name.

clue.text: Dissolute host heralded initially by one with port

parts.note: a host is a large crowd, a lot

indicators.note: the first letter of the next word

parts.note: a means one
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A debauched party-giver is announced by someone carrying port wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' suggests the drink but is the Brazilian city. 'by' and 'with' just join.
explanation.definitionFit: A rake or womaniser lives a dissolute life; the noun stands for the adjective here.

clue.text: Determined chap breaking law in spring

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go inside the word for spring

parts.note: to spring is to jump or start

indicators.note: the word law is broken up and its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A resolute man breaks the law in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' gives LWA; 'Determined' looks like the whole definition, but 'chap' belongs with it, since a stalwart is a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A loyal, steadfast supporter is a firm, resolute person.

clue.text: Man, perhaps, succeeded interrupting retired priest

indicators.note: the abbreviation breaks into the reversed priest
to retire is to go back, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: Eli was the priest who raised Samuel in the Old Testament
S is short for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: A man has followed on and interrupted a priest who has stepped down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man in the Irish Sea; 'perhaps' marks it as an example. 'retired' reverses ELI to ILE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man is one example of an island.

clue.text: Football team continually followed by fashionable set

parts.note: ever means always or continually
the ton is high society, the fashionable world

explanation.surface: A football club is always trailed by trendy people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'followed by' just joins EVER and TON in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A Premier League club from Liverpool.

clue.text: Cigar leading figure produced in bed

indicators.note: the hero is put inside the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a hero is the leading figure in a story

explanation.surface: The star of the show smokes a cigar in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading figure' suggests a single initial letter, but here it is the hero of a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cigar cut square at both ends.

clue.text: Secret society about to beset a second bishop

indicators.note: to surround, so the abbreviation wraps round the rest

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about
a mo is a moment, a second
RR, Right Reverend, is a bishop's title

explanation.surface: A secret society is about to surround a deputy bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to beset' puts the inner pieces between the two letters of the abbreviation for about; RR, Right Reverend, is a bishop's title.
explanation.definitionFit: The Neapolitan crime organisation, comparable to the Mafia.

clue.text: Extended property with grounds

explanation.definitionFit: Stretched out; also an American word for a large ranch or estate.

clue.text: Chapter with line on international revolutionary is well-worn material

parts.note: Che Guevara was the Argentine revolutionary

explanation.surface: A chapter about a revolutionary is very hackneyed stuff.
explanation.definitionFit: A stock, overused phrase or idea is stale writing.

clue.text: Good fortune for airman

parts.note: pi, short for pious, means good
one's lot is one's fate or fortune

explanation.surface: An airman has good luck.
explanation.definitionFit: The flyer who flies a plane.

clue.text: Prepared meal includes bit of meat, then processed cheese

indicators.note: a meal that is prepared is made up, so the letters are reworked
the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A cooked dish contains a morsel of meat, then processed cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prepared' rearranges MEAL + M + THEN; 'processed' reinforces the mix and suggests the cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss hard cheese with large holes.

clue.text: Simple boy reared to accept king

indicators.note: the reversed boy takes in the king
in a down clue, rearing up means reading upwards, so backwards

parts.note: Dean is a boy's name
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A boy brought up to obey a king is plain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reared' turns DEAN into NAED, and K goes in to make NAKED.
explanation.definitionFit: Unadorned, plain and bare, as in the naked truth.

clue.text: Interview bridge players in front of table

parts.note: E and N, East and North, are two players at the bridge table
a counter is a flat table, as in a shop

explanation.surface: Bridge players are interviewed before the table.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting face to face with someone.

clue.text: Country profession given a hearing

indicators.note: the word for profession is listened to, so it is spoken

parts.note: a career is a profession

explanation.surface: A country's line of work gets a fair hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation in East Asia, split North and South.

clue.text: Proper fight finishing early

indicators.note: the word stops before its last letter

parts.note: a duel is a formal fight

explanation.surface: A fair fight ends too soon.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitting, as in due care or due respect.

clue.text: FT ad almost no-one had treated with much attention

indicators.note: letters that are treated are processed and rearranged
the last letter of the word is dropped

explanation.surface: Nobody had dealt with an FT advert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims NO-ONE to NOON; 'treated' rearranges FT + AD + NOON + HAD.
explanation.definitionFit: As in waiting on someone hand and foot: serving them devotedly.
